name: player_reset_a
about: Harness self-test, the first of a pair (records run in path order within a boot): the player is given a knife, wields it through the melee verb slot (slot2) and crouches through `player_crouch`, and the probes at 2.5 s read both (timed, not `end`: a run whose expectations and timed probes are all met ends there, so end-only probes would read at zero, before any action). `player_reset_b`, the next record of the boot, then reads a player at rest. Reported as `fail`, a probe or an action did not take: the pair proves nothing until it does.
